messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 6.0s for service= inference-api-prod (region=us-west-2). Threshold crossed. Graph: https://metrics.internal/redwood/graphs/5999 :eyes:
pagerduty-bot: Pager fired -> oncall rotation (PD #INC12345) :rotating_light:
Ava: Acked. I'm oncall. Checking KV cache heatmaps and autoscaler logs now.
Ravi: I see p99 spike concentrated on shard gw-12, KV cache eviction rate +20% over last 5m, hotkey-ish.
Maya: Any deploys in the last hour?
Ava: No model deploys. There was a sidecar canary (sidecar:v2.1) rolled 2h ago but traffic was minimal.
Jin: Quick infra check: `kubectl get pods -l app=inference -n prod -o wide`
Jin: pods are up, 12/12 ready across gw-12 but queue_depth for gw-12 is ~380 (normal ~30).
Ravi: So not crash, it's backpressure. Upstream tokenization spikes seen on tokenizer-prod in same AZ.
Ava: Initiating traffic shift for gw-12 to fallback variant (lower-latency model) to buy time. Command: `redwood route set --shard gw-12 --variant fast-1`
incident-bot: Action logged: traffic routing change initiated by Ava at 6998765510.
Maya: Can we warm KV after routing? Suggest running `cache-warm --source samples --keys hotkeys.txt` to prefill prefixes.
Ravi: Starting warm job now, progress 0% -> 35% in 30s. p99 trending down to ~3.2s after 90s.
pagerduty-bot: PD update: incident acknowledged by Ava. Status: acknowledged.
Ava: Good progress. Monitoring for 10m. If tail doesn't recover to <4s we'll roll back the sidecar canary and trigger full incident page.
Maya: I'll draft a short CS note: "Intermittent latency increase impacting a small subset of requests in US-W region; mitigation in progress."
Jin: Autoscaler metrics show tokenizer instances hitting CPU saturation spikes. I've opened INFRA-1872 to scale tokenizer pool and reduce upstream queueing.
Ava: Thanks team. Marking incident as in-progress. Will update every 5m or on any change. If p99 <4s sustained for 5m we close the PD. :thumbsup:
